description: Authoritative machine-readable state of ODay Plus release Gate 0 through Gate 6. Validated by scripts/e2e/check_release_gate_registry.py; see docs/evidence/gates/README.md for the schema and update rules.

release.decision_note: NO-GO. No gate carries a passing receipt bound to the release candidate SHA. The P0 closeout program ODP-PLAN-GAP-CLOSEOUT-2026-07-30 is still open and ODP-PLAN-FINAL-GATE-AUDIT-001 has not run. Deterministic product-E2E readiness recorded in docs/evidence/PRODUCT_RELEASE_GO_NO_GO.md is not release readiness.

gates.name: Code Gate
gates.scope: All code releases: formatting, lint, static/type checks, unit and component tests, and build artifacts traceable to the exact release commit SHA.
required_checks: lint and format checks pass on the release candidate commit
static/type checks pass where configured
unit tests pass for changed backend and domain logic
component tests pass for changed frontend surfaces
build artifacts are immutable and traceable to the release candidate SHA

evidence.description: Aggregate bootstrap/lint/security/test/smoke/node-check target that backs the Code Gate.
GitHub Actions CI job that must be green on the exact release candidate commit.
Human-facing Code Gate checklist rows this gate summarises.

blockers: No Code Gate receipt is bound to release candidate e496be62c47c45d758681b8a4d3abfae16f1c96d; a green CI run on an earlier commit is not a receipt for this candidate.
ODP-PLAN-ENGINEERING-HARDENING-001 (OpenAPI, frontend dependency, and documentation hardening) is open.

gates.name: Contract Gate
gates.scope: API, event, data-contract, and model interface changes: OpenAPI/AsyncAPI diffs, schema compatibility, and migration/rollback plans for breaking changes.
required_checks: OpenAPI diff reviewed for breaking changes
event schema compatibility checked
data contract compatibility checked
model input/output compatibility checked
breaking changes carry migration, compatibility window, and rollback plan

evidence.description: Contract test suite covering API, event, and shared frontend domain contracts.
API contract documentation set the OpenAPI diff is reviewed against.
Web-to-API binding matrix used to spot unbound or drifted surfaces.

blockers: No Contract Gate receipt is bound to release candidate e496be62c47c45d758681b8a4d3abfae16f1c96d.
ODP-PLAN-ENGINEERING-HARDENING-001 must close the OpenAPI and frontend dependency hardening gap before contract compatibility can be attested.

gates.name: Data Gate
gates.scope: Data ingestion, canonical mapping, dbt/transformation, and feature/view changes: quality, freshness, lineage, point-in-time correctness, backfill, and quarantine paths.
required_checks: source contract and sample data reviewed
canonical mapping tests pass
data quality tests pass
freshness and lineage evidence captured
point-in-time correctness checked for model-ready data
backfill, retry, and quarantine paths tested where applicable

evidence.description: Durable persistence wiring evidence for the transactional and analytical data path.
Data contract and canonical model documentation set.
Fail-closed live data-plane gate that reconciles deployed data against a commit-bound manifest.

blockers: No Data Gate receipt is bound to release candidate e496be62c47c45d758681b8a4d3abfae16f1c96d.
check_live_production_data.py has not been run against a live deployment of this candidate; deterministic fixtures and source stubs do not satisfy the Data Gate.

gates.name: Model and Solver Gate
gates.scope: Model or decision-model promotion and optimization releases: dataset snapshots, baseline/segment/calibration metrics, model cards, hard-constraint feasibility, infeasibility diagnostics, and rollback paths.
required_checks: dataset snapshot is reproducible and hash-identified
baseline comparison and segment metrics reviewed
calibration or coverage checked where applicable
model card or decision card completed
human approval and rollback path recorded
solver hard constraints, feasibility, infeasibility diagnostics, and runtime report captured

evidence.description: Recorded production model risk acceptance that this gate must supersede with real release evidence.
ML closeout packet referenced for model lifecycle evidence conventions.

gates.name: Security and Privacy Gate
gates.scope: All production or sensitive releases: secret scanning, dependency and SAST findings, RBAC/ABAC enforcement, sensitive export and audit controls, IAM/infrastructure review, and OSS licence compliance.

dependency and SAST scans pass with no unresolved critical/high findings
RBAC/ABAC tests pass for affected roles
sensitive export and audit controls checked
IAM and infrastructure changes reviewed
licence-aware SBOM produced and OSS licence gate passes
